profile.name: authrim-current-core-shard
profile.scope: One core shard; canonical PII/admin/control/lookup streams are not combined into it.
profile.pii: users_core points to benchmark-pii-out-of-scope; no users_pii records or PII DB are created.
profile.metadata: Three real metadata_json fields per account; each has a random hexadecimal value.
profile.passkeysPerAccount: One primary plus one secondary for every fourth account.
limitations: Synthetic storage distribution, not a replay of real Authrim traffic or user data.
Passkey material is synthetic storage data and cannot authenticate.
No PII data or external storage is included; this measures a core-shard dump only.
Hexadecimal metadata has four bits of entropy per output byte.
Canonical legacy users table is retained in the schema but remains unpopulated.

methodology.transport: D1 raw export -> Worker -> private R2; private R2 -> Worker -> FK-wrapped SQL statement chunks in private R2; chunks -> Worker -> D1 import temporary R2 -> sequential ingest
methodology.resumedImportPolling: 5s per poll, serial same-bookmark retries with 100ms delay; only polling requests are retried
methodology.restorationSql: PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF prefix and ON suffix per SQL-boundary chunk; full FK check after all chunks
methodology.postImportForeignKeys: Separate final R2 SQL file containing only PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON and SELECT 1 imported after all data parts; require API+binding ON in three consecutive observations
methodology.quickCheck: All application tables and sqlite_schema checked separately; global quick_check returned SQLITE_NOMEM on this schema
methodology.fingerprintQueryStrategy: v2 forces existing primary-key range indexes and aggregates outbox once; coverage and hash semantics preserved; individual measurements identify legacy-v1 or v2
